title: 高二十五题：瓷片与剧场
source_form_notice: 高二另一普通阶段卷五材料2/3/3/4/3已核，不能由既有三材料十题替代；源录音/脚本/听力键缺，原校认证未建立。源逐段声音角色未独立听核，本稿4对话1独白为允许的本机实现，不冒称源原录音角色全已核。本稿完整原创配套非gold或独立难度验证。
teacher_source_notice: 高二另一普通阶段卷五材料2/3/3/4/3已核，不能由既有三材料十题替代；源录音/脚本/听力键缺，原校认证未建立。源逐段声音角色未独立听核，本稿4对话1独白为允许的本机实现，不冒称源原录音角色全已核。本稿完整原创配套非gold或独立难度验证。
source_scoring_notice: 该源节15题、每题1.5分，共22.5分。每段两遍，听前听后每题5秒；间隔一秒与重播提示属本机编排。
format_summary: 5材料 / 2+3+3+4+3共15回应 / 三选 / 每段2遍 / 本稿4对话1独白（源逐段角色未独立核证）
instruction: 听全部五段材料，按2题、3题、3题、4题、3题的顺序完成全部15题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段两遍，听前、听后各按每题5秒留时。审阅可重播，非正式次数控制。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I have packed the old tiles in one large box.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That may be too heavy to lift safely. Divide them between three smaller boxes and put padding between the layers.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I will. The extra boxes will also fit better in the car.

questions.rationale: A：不是瓷片年代；B：明确大箱过重；C：不关车色

options: Carry the box on the roof.
questions.rationale: A：改三小箱；B：要加层间衬垫非去掉；C：未放车顶

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The theatre has offered our club free tickets, but we would have to sit separately.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That would make discussing the production difficult.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Not necessarily. We could meet in the cafe afterwards. I would rather see the play for free than insist on sitting together.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: You are right. Let us accept. We should tell members about the seating before they sign up.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I will include that in the message, along with the cafe address.

questions.stem: What condition comes with the free tickets?
questions.rationale: A：未要求后台服务；B：未要求消费；C：明确分散座位

questions.stem: Where could the club discuss the play?
options: In the school bus before it starts.
questions.rationale: A：明确看后咖啡馆讨论；B：未借舞台；C：未提校车

questions.stem: What should members know before signing up?
options: The price of every cafe item.
questions.rationale: A：不是演员住址；B：明确先告知分座；C：只给地址非全部菜单价格

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I compared the two translations of the poem. The older one keeps the rhyme, but leaves out the image of the river.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: And the new one?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: It keeps that image, though it does not rhyme. I think the image matters more to the meaning.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Would you use only the new version in your presentation?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No. Showing both will make the choices clearer. I will also read the original line, so the audience can hear its sound.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Then explain the trade-off rather than calling one version completely wrong.

questions.stem: What does the older translation omit?
questions.rationale: A：明确省略河流意象；B：未说整节删除；C：未说署名缺失

questions.stem: Why does the man prefer an aspect of the new version?
questions.rationale: A：未比较长度；B：新版不押韵；C：重视保留意义相关意象

options: Both translations and an original line.
A new biography instead of the poem.
questions.rationale: A：计划两版都展示；B：明确加朗读原句；C：不是改为传记

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The interviews for our local history project are nearly finished. Can we put them straight online?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Not yet. Two people agreed to classroom use only, and one wants her surname removed.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I thought signing the form covered everything.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The form had separate choices for classroom use and public sharing. We need to respect each person's choice.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Then I will mark which extracts can be shared. What about the spelling of place names?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Ask each speaker to check the transcript. The old map uses a spelling that some residents no longer recognise.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Should we correct their speech to match the map?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No. Keep what they said, and add a note about the two spellings. That disagreement is part of the evidence.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Good. I will prepare separate classroom and public versions.

questions.stem: Why cannot all interviews go online?
questions.rationale: A：无文件体积问题；B：明确各人同意范围不同；C：网站未关闭
A：无增音量请求；B：无翻译请求；C：明确去姓

questions.stem: Who should check the place-name spellings?
questions.rationale: A：明确请每位受访者核逐字稿；B：不是网页设计师独断；C：不由卖地图者决定

questions.stem: How will different spellings be handled?
options: Replace all speech with map wording.
Keep the speech and add an explanatory note.
questions.rationale: A：不为地图强改原话；B：明确保留话语并作注；C：不删除分歧证据

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: Our town's repair cafe has completed its first year. Volunteers looked at a hundred and eighty objects, but that figure includes items they could not fix. Ninety-two were repaired, while the owners of another forty learned what spare part they needed. The remaining forty-eight were beyond the team's equipment or skills. Please remember these distinctions when using the numbers in your reports. Next year we will introduce appointments for electrical items, because each check can take a long time. Clothes and simple mechanical objects can still be brought without an appointment. There is no charge, though donations help buy materials. The cafe cannot guarantee a repair, and owners should not leave objects at the door when volunteers are absent.

questions.stem: What does the figure 180 refer to?
questions.rationale: A：成功修好仅92；B：明确全部查看物品；C：不是预约数量

questions.stem: Why will electrical items need appointments?
options: They are always the most expensive.
There are no volunteers for them.
Their checks may take a long time.
questions.rationale: A：不是按价格；B：仍有志愿者检查；C：明确耗时

options: Every visitor must pay a fixed fee.
All objects should be left outside.
questions.rationale: A：明确不能保证修好；B：无固定费捐款自愿；C：志愿者不在不可门口留物
